purpose: Add the current leakage-safe 30-day thermal anomaly unchanged to each expanding prior-year target climatology.
outputs: anomaly_persistence_forecast.json using the common three-horizon forecast schema
failure_conditions: state's claimed last complete date is not complete in legal canonical observations
provenance_generated: eligible historical and recent legal observation-slice hashes
scientific_assumptions: current anomaly is recent 30-day mean minus matched expanding historical climatology
recent and historical windows require 27 of 30 daily means
climatologies use observations from years strictly earlier than issue year
the anomaly is added unchanged to all three target climatologies
verification targets are not an input
manifest_status: internal portability aid; not an official LifeWatch manifest
